text: The major is designed to train professionals with good math literacy and better computer skills. It is a wide covering field. Graduates have strong capabilities in computer software applications and development and initial network design with the grasp of the basic tenets of modern communication and strong mathematical modeling capabilities so that they can apply scientific calculation methods and tools to solve practical problems. Graduates are qualified for such jobs as information processing and decision-making, computer-aided design, scientific and engineering computing, systems management and office automation and computer applications management in the field of education, scientific research, communications, and other enterprises. By giving full play to the advantages in the disciplines of information of the university, it has become an interdisciplinary. At the same time, it focuses on solid foundation training for a strong adaptability.
